batch.title: Zaxby's Item 19 read from the primary document
batch.task_prompt: Read Item 19 of the newest Zaxby's FDD available and compare it with the figure CSW publishes.
batch.summary: Read from the source. NOT SUBMITTED — the finding is that CSW's figure is the median labelled as an average, and mean-vs-median is a definition question for the owner that affects every other Item 19 figure. Recorded here so the evidence survives the container; the PDF itself is re-downloadable in seconds with scripts/fdd-fetch.py.

document.note: This is the newest Zaxby's FDD in CARDS. Wisconsin shows a registration effective 2026-04-24; CARDS does not carry it yet. Lag between state registries is normal.

item19.table: Table 1 — Average Gross Revenues of Franchised Restaurants
item19.excluded: 143 affiliate-owned (Zax Restaurants), 13 closed >1 month, 37 opened during period, 7 closed during period
item19.systemwide_context: 969 open and operating restaurants as of 2024-12-29, of which 826 third-party franchised

decisions.subject: brand.metrics.auvUsd, all brands
decisions.finding: CSW publishes 2710000 for Zaxby's. That is the MEDIAN gross revenues in this table, not the average (2782488). Same document, same period, wrong statistic.
decisions.why_it_matters: Every Item 19 figure pulled from now on faces the same fork, and several brands publish mean and median by quartile. Picking per-brand would make the ranking incomparable across brands, which is worse than either choice made consistently.
options: Average of all measured units — the more common reading of 'AUV', and what most trade press quotes.
Median of all measured units — less skewed by the top quartile, arguably the better central estimate for a franchisee's expected outcome.
decisions.consequence: Whichever is chosen, /methodology/ has to say so, and the existing Zaxby's figure is corrected either by relabelling it as median or by replacing it with 2782488.

conflicts_resolved.subject: Zaxby's AUV
conflicts_resolved.was: Two FDD aggregator sites gave $2,847,345 and $2,544,354 — a $303k spread on a figure that decides a rank.
conflicts_resolved.now: Neither matches the primary document. The mean is $2,782,488 and the median $2,710,374; both aggregator values are wrong. The conflict is closed by the source rather than by picking a side.
conflicts_resolved.lesson: Reachable is not sourced. This is the worked example.
